# Aswanth K.T — Full Stack Developer

> Full Stack (MERN) Developer at Talkisam Private Limited (since August 2026), based in Kannur, Kerala, India. Open to opportunities.

Before software, Aswanth spent 4.5 years as a Front Line Supervisor at L&T Construction (Railways Division), leading live track construction crews with zero safety incidents.

## Experience
- Full Stack Developer — Talkisam Private Limited (Aug 2026 – present): Tokify emotional-wellness app — Node.js/Express APIs, audio/video calling with Socket.io, OTP/Google/Apple sign-in, Razorpay coin wallet, React admin dashboard and safety tools, customer support app (email, WhatsApp, tickets)
- MERN Stack Developer — Hall Dot X (Mar 2026 – Aug 2026): gym management platform, WhatsApp Cloud API reminders, 15+ REST endpoints, RBAC with JWT
- MERN Stack Development Bootcamp — Brototype (Sep 2024 – Nov 2025)
- Front Line Supervisor — L&T Construction, Railways Division (Sep 2018 – Feb 2023)

## Skills
Node.js, Express.js, React.js, Redux, JavaScript (ES6+), Tailwind CSS, Socket.io, MongoDB, Mongoose, Redis, JWT, OTP / Google / Apple sign-in, Passport.js, RBAC, AWS EC2, Nginx, PM2, GitHub Actions, Firebase, Vercel, Render, Netlify, Razorpay, Cloudinary, Git
